Anant sinh aaj suprim kort se jhatka milne ke bad pres konphrens kar rahe the. jaise hi patrakaron ne unse lalan sinh ke bare men puchha vo bharak gae. dekhie pres konphrens ke dauran achanak aisa kya huaa ki anant sinh naraj ho gae...
